SIXTHAMENDMENT
To Lease Agreement by and between
1) Mr. Zaheer Ahmed Sb Dhani Bux 2) Mr. Nazeer Ahmed Panhwar Sb Dhani
Bux (collectively the "Lessor") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited (the
"Lessee")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]

This sixth amendment ("Sixth Amendment') to the Lease Agreement dated 28th February,2020
amended through First Amendment dated 9th June, 2020, Second Amendment dated 18th
May, 2021, Third Amendment dated l5' April, 2022, Fourth Amendment dated 151h March,
2023 and Fifth Amendment dated 29th February, 2024 (collectively referred to as the
"Agreement") is made and entered into at Karachi on this day of February, 2025.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on lease, and the
Lessee took on Lease from the Lessor, the ground and mezzanine floors of the
commercial bui'ding measuring 4600sq. ft (forty-six hundred square feet), located at SB15, Block 07: SCH 36, Gulistan -e- Johar. Main University Road, Karachi ('Demised
Premises'); and

J.

(B)

The Parties here by mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement ,as per the
terms and conditions of this Sixth Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Sixth Amendment shall come in to force

l' February, 2025 (the "Effectives Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 2.2 of the Agreement, the Parties here by mutually agree to extend
the term of the Agreement for a further period of eleven (11) months, commencing from
the Effective Date and ending on 31st December, 2025 (the "Extended Term").

3.

The Parties hereby agree that the Monthly Rent of the Demised Premises is hereby
increased by 10%. Accordingly, the monthly rent payable by the Land lord to the Tenant
for the Extended Term is Rs. 790,735 (Rupees Seven Hundred Ninety Thousand Seven
Hundred Thirty Fifty) inclusive of withholding taxes ("Monthly Rent").

4.

The Sixth Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this Sixth Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning
in this Sixth Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This Sixth Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties here to have signed this Sixth Amendment, having
fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of
witnesses.
